title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E02 — From SNL to Pause Star, Comedian Sam Jay
Maiysha sits down with comic and TV writer Sam Jay about her HBO series "Pause"; she also dishes on her Peacock show "Bust Down" and her time on SNL.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E03 — The Son of Baldwin, Robert Jones Jr.
Maiysha talks with New York Times bestselling author and "Son of Baldwin" creator Robert Jones Jr. about his book "The Prophets"; he explains how he came up with the concept of a novel about Black queer love during slavery.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E04 — From the Big Screen to Your Book Shelf, Legendary Actor Omar Epps
Maiysha Kai sits down with actor Omar Epps, who gives an introspective look at his love for hip-hop, the film industry and the importance of being prepared for success.

title: The Blackest Questions With Dr. Christina Greer
description:
S01 E04 — Cookout Starts at 5, What Time Will You Be There? : Tanya Nolan
Songstress and Galveston, Texas, native Tanya Nolan shows off more than her vocal range; she can hold a tune, but she tries to hold it down with her Black history knowledge.

title: The Blackest Questions With Dr. Christina Greer
description:
S01 E05 — Is Mac & Cheese a Main Dish or a Side Dish? Michael Twitty

title: The Blackest Questions With Dr. Christina Greer
description:
S01 E06 — Luther Vandross or Barry White?: LaTosha Brown
Voting rights activist LaTosha Brown is on the ballot and goes to the wire with Dr. Christina Greer; no election fraud or hanging chads, just trivia and celebrating Blackness.

description:

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E05 — The Person Behind the Viral Hashtag #DisabledandCute: Keah Brown
